summary: The PR adds an optional keyword-only `limit` argument to `Table.search`, returning at most `limit` matching documents in stored order. It validates `limit` as a positive integer on both cached and uncached paths, works on named tables, and leaves behavior unchanged when `limit` is omitted. All 4 new acceptance tests pass and the full existing test suite passes.

checks.claim: limit returns at most N matching docs in stored order
checks.evidence: tests/test_autose_limit.py AC-1/AC-2 pass; python -m pytest tests/test_autose_limit.py -v -> 4 passed

checks.claim: no limit returns all matches unchanged
invalid limit raises ValueError; caching + limit works
checks.evidence: python -c snippet: limit=0/-1/'x' raise ValueError; cached search with limit=2 returns correct ids
